prose: ElevenLabs launches Eleven v4, its most emotive text-to-speech model, plus the low-latency Eleven v4 Turbo. The pitch is prosody with intent: 'I need you to stay calm' should sound different from a doctor to a frightened patient than from a squad leader dropping into battle, and v4 interprets tone, pacing, emotion, character, and context while preserving speaker identity. It ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis and was preferred by ~75% of listeners in blind head-to-head tests. A new architecture improves multi-speaker dynamics so dialogue responds to conversational context rather than sounding assembled line by line.
highlights: Eleven v4: ElevenLabs' most emotive TTS model, plus a low-latency Turbo variant
